start.content: Governments are not built on passion, young man. They are built on stone and historical continuity. I have watched procurators come and go. They all think they command Judea, but the temple remains. This Galilean speaks well, but he does not recognize that systems outlive prophets.

choices.text: Why bring him in at midnight instead of open day?
Do you fear his popularity among the crowd?

mechanics.content: Daylight belongs to the crowds, and crowds are easily confused by noise. Silence allows for careful administrative evaluation. -> closing

popularity.content: A crowd that shouts 'Hosanna' on Sunday will shout something entirely different by Friday if the narrative shifts. Popularity is water. -> closing
